title: Multi-Stop Route, Geocoder & 2-Opt TSP Distance Optimizer Input

origin.title: Start Location (Address or 'lat, lng')
origin.description: Starting depot, office address, or 'latitude, longitude' coordinate pair.
origin.default: Union Station, 30 W Pershing Rd, Kansas City, MO 64108
origin.prefill: Union Station, 30 W Pershing Rd, Kansas City, MO 64108

destination.title: End Location (Address, 'lat, lng', or blank for open route)
destination.description: Ending depot address or 'latitude, longitude'. Set identical to Start Location for a closed round-trip, or leave empty for an open-ended route.
destination.default: Union Station, 30 W Pershing Rd, Kansas City, MO 64108
destination.prefill: Union Station, 30 W Pershing Rd, Kansas City, MO 64108

stops.title: Stops to Optimize (Addresses or Coordinate Objects)
stops.description: Array of stop objects ({label, address, lat, lng, priority, serviceMinutes}) or plain street address strings from Google Sheets, HubSpot, Airtable, or CSV.

maxMinutes.title: Max Shift Time Window (Minutes)
maxMinutes.description: Maximum allowed cumulative minutes (driving + on-site dwell time). Stops exceeding this window are marked as Deferred.

serviceMinutesPerStop.title: Default On-Site Service Time per Stop (Minutes)
serviceMinutesPerStop.description: Default dwell or appointment duration in minutes per stop when not overridden on an individual stop.

averageSpeedMph.title: Estimated Average Driving Speed (MPH)
averageSpeedMph.description: Average urban/suburban road travel speed in miles per hour used for travel-time estimation.

roadCircuityPercent.title: Road Circuity Multiplier (%)
roadCircuityPercent.description: Multiplier applied to straight-line Haversine distance to approximate real street grids (128 = 1.28x Haversine distance).
